consultation.ai.clarificationVoiceHelp: In conversation mode, answer naturally out loud. You can also type your answer below.
consultation.ai.subtitleControlled: Chat, review, then accept or reject each proposed change.
consultation.ai.startControlledHelp: No proposal is accepted or saved automatically.
consultation.ai.modeConversationHelp: The assistant speaks; you start each voice reply and then review its transcript.
consultation.ai.modeControlledHelp: Review the transcript before asking the assistant to analyze it.
consultation.ai.dictationModeHelp: One recording at a time for review
consultation.ai.chooseVoiceModeHelp: Only one microphone mode runs at a time. You can switch modes later.
consultation.ai.startRealtimeModeHelp: Continuous conversation with a Realtime-managed microphone
consultation.ai.voiceSubtitle: Clinical voice conversation, targeted questions, structured notes, and explicit medical validation.
consultation.ai.startRealtimeHelp: The assistant listens, structures, and asks questions. No clinical data is accepted or saved automatically.
consultation.ai.realtimeGovernedHelp: The microphone stays live, while every clinical datum still passes through Joprelys validation.
consultation.ai.realtimeRecoveryHelp: Do not continue dictating until reconnection is complete: Joprelys is restoring the microphone automatically.
consultation.ai.realtimeMicLost: The microphone stopped providing audio. Reconnecting automatically…
consultation.ai.realtimeAutoplayError: Tap the screen, then re-enable copilot audio.
consultation.ai.realtimeChannelError: The real-time audio link failed. Reconnecting automatically…
consultation.ai.realtimeUnavailable: Realtime is temporarily unavailable. Automatic reconnection is in progress.
consultation.ai.realtimeUnsupported: This browser does not support the real-time audio connection.
consultation.ai.realtimeNotConfigured: Realtime is not configured on the server.
consultation.ai.realtimeAccessDenied: The OpenAI key used by the server does not have Realtime access.
consultation.ai.realtimeQuotaExceeded: The OpenAI Realtime quota is exhausted or temporarily rate-limited.
consultation.ai.realtimeSessionExpired: The AI session expired. Restart the voice copilot.
consultation.ai.realtimeModelUnavailable: The Realtime model or configuration is not available for this account.
consultation.ai.realtimeNetworkError: The network connection to Realtime is unavailable. Automatic reconnection is in progress.
consultation.ai.realtimeConnectionFailed: The WebRTC connection could not be established. Automatic reconnection is in progress.
consultation.ai.realtimeClinicalError: The sentence was heard, but its clinical analysis failed.
consultation.ai.noSpeechDetected: No speech detected. Move closer to the microphone and try again.
consultation.ai.revisionHelp: The accepted draft remains unchanged until you make a decision.
consultation.ai.revisionGovernanceHelp: The copilot only makes proposals. Data remains unchanged until you explicitly approve it.
consultation.ai.acceptedDraftGovernanceH: Consultation notes, prescriptions, tests, and vital signs remain under the healthcare professional’s control.
consultation.ai.simpleSubtitle: Speak naturally. Joprelys listens, structures, and lets you validate clinical information.
consultation.ai.chooseHowToWork: How would you like to work?
consultation.ai.chooseHowToWorkHelp: Choose a mode. You can switch later without losing the consultation.
consultation.ai.realtimeSimpleHelp: Talk with the patient while Joprelys continuously listens and transcribes.
consultation.ai.dictationSimpleHelp: Dictate a passage, then review the transcript before analysis.
consultation.ai.dictationFocusedHelp: Dictate a passage, stop, then review it before analysis.
consultation.ai.microphoneSignalWaiting: Speak: the bars react only to audio actually captured
consultation.ai.textPlaceholder: Example: Correct this, the pain is on the right, not the left…
consultation.ai.focusTranscriptUnverifie: Text was heard but confidence cannot be verified. It remains visible and is not automatically used as a clinical fact.
consultation.ai.focusTranscriptWaiting: Speak normally. The last recognized sentence will appear here.
consultation.ai.focusTranscriptNoChannel: Transcription will start as soon as the audio channel is confirmed.
consultation.ai.pausedHelp: Listening is paused. Press Resume to continue.
consultation.ai.assistantSpeakingHelp: Listen to Joprelys, then answer naturally.
consultation.ai.focusHearingHelp: Your voice is detected by the Realtime channel. Keep speaking normally.
consultation.ai.catchingUpHelp: Joprelys is processing queued sentences. The microphone stays active, so you can keep speaking.
consultation.ai.simpleListeningHelp: Speak naturally. The transcript appears when each sentence is finalized.
consultation.ai.reconnectingProtectedHel: Your consultation remains protected while audio reconnects.
consultation.ai.audioUnavailableHelp: Do not continue the voice consultation until audio is restored.
consultation.ai.storageCriticalSimple: Safety storage is almost full. Restore connectivity or free space before continuing.
consultation.ai.realtimeProtectedReconne: Realtime was interrupted. The consultation remains locally recorded and will synchronize automatically.
consultation.ai.audioProtectionUnavailab: Audio protection is not guaranteed. Wait for recovery before continuing.
consultation.ai.ambientRequired: Audio protection is unavailable. Realtime remains disabled to prevent silent data loss.
consultation.ai.realtimeTranscriptUnveri: The sentence heard is ready for review and correction before analysis.
consultation.ai.realtimeBackpressure: Several sentences are waiting to be processed. The microphone stays active and their order is preserved.
consultation.ai.realtimeTranscriptLowCon: Review and correct the sentence heard before starting its analysis.
consultation.ai.realtimeFinishingHelp: The microphone is stopped. Joprelys is finishing received sentences and preserves any correction or validation still required.
consultation.ai.realtimeConversationAnal: The sentence was safely stored, but the assistant could not analyze it. You may continue: audio and transcript remain preserved.
consultation.clinicalNote.historyTitle: S — Subjective · History of present illness
consultation.clinicalNote.historyHelp: Onset, progression, associated symptoms, aggravating or relieving factors, and treatments already tried.
consultation.clinicalNote.historyPlaceho: Example: abdominal pain for 3 days, sudden onset, mainly in the right lower quadrant, nausea without vomiting, no diarrhea…
consultation.clinicalNote.historyRequire: History of present illness is required.
consultation.clinicalNote.examHelp: Relevant physical examination findings and important negative signs.
consultation.clinicalNote.examPlaceholde: Example: soft abdomen, right lower quadrant tenderness without guarding, bowel sounds present…
consultation.clinicalNote.assessmentHelp: Document the diagnosis retained by the practitioner.
consultation.clinicalNote.diagnosisPlace: Example: acute appendicitis suspected from the clinical presentation…
consultation.clinicalNote.summaryTitle: P — Plan · Summary and care plan
consultation.clinicalNote.summaryHelp: Clinical summary, patient instructions, and follow-up plan.
consultation.clinicalNote.summaryPlaceho: Short summary of the situation, severity, decision, and items to monitor.
consultation.clinicalNote.instructionsPl: Warning signs, lifestyle measures, and return instructions…
consultation.clinicalNote.followUpPlaceh: Example: review in 48 hours, return with results, specialist consultation…
consultation.ai.tipDictateNaturally: Tip: You can dictate your consultation notes naturally.
consultation.ai.tipVitalsNaturally: Tip: You can dictate your vital signs naturally.
consultation.ai.realtimeCorrectionFailed: The correction could not be analyzed. The transcript remains visible.
